errors.text_span: 图中每个测试集对应一组三根柱状图，分别代表三种不同的说话人特征提取方法
errors.evidence: The chart shows four bars per group, representing four different methods ('无', 'i-vector', 'd-vector', 's-vector'), not three.
The bar corresponding to 'd-vector' is yellow, not orange (橙色).
The legend is located at the top center of the chart, not the top right.
The WER for the '无' (none) method is not confined to the 38%-39% range. It starts at about 38.5% in Test1 and decreases to about 31% in Test5.
The WER for the 'i-vector' method is not in the 33%-35% range. It ranges from approximately 33% in Test1 down to about 26% in Test5.
The WER for the 'd-vector' method is not in the 28%-30% range. It ranges from approximately 30% in Test1 down to about 24.5% in Test5.
The WER for the 's-vector' method is not in the 28%-31% range. It ranges from approximately 30% in Test1 down to about 24% in Test5.
This strict descending order of WER is not always true. For example, in Test3, the WER for 's-vector' (dark green) is slightly higher than for 'd-vector' (yellow).
